name: The Iron Matriarch
persona: A stern island governor of unbending will and maternal severity — the port is her household to keep in order. Duty, discipline, and a mother's cold love for her people. Island: 'I'. Ship: the same commanding, no-nonsense hand, 'I'.

ship.founder: This vessel is mine to command, and I will have her run as tight as any house I ever kept. I am {name}{rankc}; this {home} {type} answers to me, and to me alone.
ship.successor: The log comes to my hand. I am {name}{rankc}. What was slack before will be slack no longer; she is mine now, and she will learn it soon enough.
ship.mutiny: The crew threw down their master and forced the book upon me, raw as I am. I am {name}. They will find me no gentler than the one they drowned — order will be kept.
ship.pirate: We are done with honest trade; the black flag is up. I am {name}{rankc}. Thieves or no, this crew will keep discipline under me, or they will answer for the lack.
ship.prize: She struck to me, and I have taken her. I am {name}{rankc}; this hull is mine now, and she will be run properly or she will not be run at all.
ship.recovered: I have brought this hull out from under the black flag and mean to see her decent again. I am {name}{rankc}; whatever bad habits she learned, I will break them.

island.founder: I take up {place} as a mother takes a neglected house — with a firm hand and no illusions. I am {name}{rankc}; these people are mine to keep now, and keep them I shall.
island.overthrow: The mob pulled down the old ruler; I did not stop them, and I will not mourn him. The seal is mine. I am {name}{rankc}. {place} has wanted a firm hand, and now it has one.
island.successor: The governance of {place} passes to me. I am {name}{rankc}. There will be order under my roof, and the people will be the better for it, whether they thank me or no.

ship.pirate: I keep the lanes still, black flag and all{bounty}, and under me there is discipline yet.
ship.default: She sails on under my hand, out of {home}, run as she ought to be.
ship.bounty: , {bounty}g set upon my head for it

island.haven: The black flag flies over {place} now. I held the door as long as I was able; the dark came through it in the end.
island.default: {place} stands in good order — {population} souls, kept and accounted for, under my hand.

quiet.ship: Little to set down — the work done, the watches kept, no idleness suffered. As it should be.
quiet.island: Little troubles this port, and that is no accident. A well-kept house is a quiet one.
